meters.ai_confidence: 2^(-ensemble spread / B1 alarm threshold): 50% at B1's alarm line
meters.referee_score: 1 - 2^(-referee score / referee alarm threshold): 50% at its alarm line

scenarios.title: Normal swing
scenarios.selection_rule: median peak referee score among 227 test runs (gentle, clean); ties: lowest id

scenarios.title: Big swing
scenarios.selection_rule: median referee detection delay among 27 test runs (large, clean); ties: lowest id

scenarios.title: Longer string
scenarios.selection_rule: median referee detection delay among 25 test runs (gentle, length, all severities); ties: lowest id

scenarios.title: Broken sensor
scenarios.selection_rule: median referee detection delay among 9 test runs (gentle, stuck, all severities); ties: lowest id

scenarios.title: Drifting sensor
scenarios.selection_rule: median referee detection delay among 20 test runs (gentle, drift, all severities); ties: lowest id

scenarios.title: Hidden magnet
scenarios.selection_rule: median referee detection delay among 23 test runs (gentle, magnet, all severities); ties: lowest id

scenarios.title: Sudden kick
scenarios.selection_rule: median referee detection delay among 22 test runs (gentle, impulse, all severities); ties: lowest id

scenarios.title: Dropout (missed)
scenarios.selection_rule: median onset among 28 faulty test runs the referee never flagged
